name: Ensure Diabetes Care Vanilla Delight flavour
ingredients_raw: Maltodextrin, calcium caseinate, edible vegetable oils (high oleic sunflower oil, soy oil), fructose, MINERALS** fructo-oligosaccharide (FOS) (4.12%), soy polysaccharide, flavorings (Artificial Flavoring Substances - Vanilla), VITAMINS***, m-inositol, antioxidants (soy lecithin, mixed tocopherols), taurine, L-carnitine, sucralose.
